newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-T-D Bank bids for Australian broker.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-T-D Bank bids for Australian broker.

text.p: Canada's Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Monday its discount broking unit, Green Line Investor Services, has offered A$29.76 million or A$3.57 per share to buy privately held Australian discount stock broker Pont Securities.
"The Pont offer reflects our strategy of continuing to expand our discount broking activity globally," T-D Bank executive vice president Duncan Gibson said in a statement.
Green Line chief executive Keith Gray said his group wanted to participate in the active and growing Australian market.
"We believe we can add value to the Australian discount broking market through our global experience and through service standards which are proven," Gray said in the same statement.
Gray said Pont's management and employees would remain unchanged if the bid was successful.

Pont Managing Director Keith Amor said Pont received the offer on Monday morning and its board now had 14 days to consider the offer and make a recommendation to its 33 shareholders. Pont Chairman Greg Moore owns 50 percent of Pont.
Pont, which has 60 staff, had discussions with Greenline before the bid, Amor told Reuters.
Green Line said it and T-D Bank's Waterhouse Investor Services Inc of New York represented the third largest discount broking group in the world.
